items: E-commerce Act (ehandelsloven, LOV-2003-05-23-35) § 8, the service provider's duty to disclose information: name, address, e-mail address and other details allowing direct contact; the business register and organisation number; VAT status; and any required authorisations with the name and address of the authority. The information must be "enkelt og direkte tilgjengelig" (easily and directly accessible). https://lovdata.no/lov/2003-05-23-35/§8 (opened 2026-09-26).

Whether a free marketing website alone is an "information society service" (§ 1: "normally provided for remuneration") is **UNVERIFIED**. This page is recommended regardless. The hosted platform is covered.
Whether "authorisations" applies to {brand}'s activity is **UNVERIFIED**; the expected answer is none.
